prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single, objectively “best” lawyer for every truck‑accident case in Dallas. The right lawyer depends on your injuries, the truck/insurer involved, whether you need trial experience, and your personal preferences. I can help you find strong options, but first here’s how to identify the best one for your situation and what to ask.

How to pick the best Dallas truck‑accident lawyer
- Relevant experience: look for attorneys who focus on commercial truck cases (not just general personal injury). Truck cases involve FMCSA rules, logbooks/ELDs, DOT inspections, employer/lease relationships, and reconstruction.
- Trial experience: choose a lawyer who actually tries cases to verdict when necessary, not only settles.
- Resources: the firm should have access to accident reconstructionists, vocational experts, medical experts, and the financial resources to investigate and litigate against large trucking companies and insurers.
- Track record: ask for representative settlements/verdicts in truck cases and references from past clients (recognize confidentiality limits).
- Credentials & reputation: check State Bar status, board certification (Texas Board of Legal Specialization — Personal Injury Trial Law), peer-review ratings (Martindale‑Hubbell), Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, and client reviews.
- Communication & fit: you want someone who explains strategy, responds promptly, and will keep you informed.
- Fees & costs: most personal injury lawyers work on contingency, but ask about the percentage, who pays upfront costs, and how expenses are handled if you don’t recover.

What to ask in a free consultation
- How many truck cases have you handled? How many in Dallas county?
- Do you try cases to verdict? Recent trial results?
- Who will handle my case day‑to‑day (attorney vs. paralegal)?
- Do you have experience with FMCSA/ELD/logbook evidence and accident reconstruction?
- What is your fee structure and who advances case costs?
- Can you provide references or client testimonials?
- What is a realistic range of outcomes for my type of injury?

Where to find and verify top lawyers
- Texas State Bar (attorney records and disciplinary history)
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (for board certification)
- Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, The National Trial Lawyers
- Local Dallas bar association lawyer referral service
- Read multiple client reviews (Google, Avvo) and compare.

Immediate practical steps after a truck accident
- Seek and document medical care right away; keep all records.
- Preserve evidence: photos, truck number, driver’s license/tag, employer info, witness contacts.
- Get a copy of the police crash report and request the driver’s logbook/ELD and carrier info.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers before talking to an attorney.

If you want, I can:
- Narrow a short list of well‑rated Dallas truck‑accident attorneys (if you want me to, tell me your ZIP code and any preferences), or
- Provide a checklist you can bring to consults, or
- Draft an email you can send to prospective lawyers requesting a consultation.
